title: SQL: Serialize Intervals and GeoShapes as Strings

timeline.message: Serialize Intervals and GeoShapes as Strings
timeline.author: Andrei Stefan

timeline.body:
LGTM - a small update to a somewhat bigger problem.
Likely in the future we should move away from serializing `NamedWritable`s in the payload as it offers no benefit to the consumer (RestAction).

timeline.author: Andrei Stefan

timeline.body: Minor, but I'd prefer a new variable declared as String, instead of assigning to the method arg.
